info.description:
The contract between the Jelly server and its clients, the desktop app and the stage page.

**Authentication:** A player sends `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. A new secret only arrives from `POST /v1/auth/redeem` or `POST /v1/auth/recover`, and clients keep it to themselves. The stage page reads with the stage key in the query `key`, which allows reading only.

**Units:** All times are milliseconds since 1970 in server time. Use `server_time` from an answer for countdowns instead of the clock of the device. All positions on the stage are percent of the room. Distances in rules such as `near_distance` and `walk_speed` count jelly units: a jelly is about 1.7 wide, the hall 21 wide and 40 deep.

**Growth:** Answers can gain fields, event types, catalog entries, enum values and error codes in any version, so clients ignore what they do not know. Requests reject unknown fields. A breaking change gets a new path version.

**Errors:** Every error has the form `{"error":{"code","message"}}`. `code` is stable and meant for code, `message` is German and meant for people, so show it for unknown codes. `invalid_request` answers with 400 (no valid JSON), 408 or 413 (body too slow or too large), 415 (not JSON) or 422 (unknown or missing field, wrong type). After a network error, read `GET /v1/players/me` before repeating an action, because it may have counted already. `401` means the secret is no longer valid. Never delete a secret because of a network error.

**Error codes:** New ones can appear in any version.

| Status | Code | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | `invalid_request` | Die Anfrage ist ungültig. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Diesen Weg gibt es nicht. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Zu viele Versuche, bitte warten. |

| 403 | `invalid_code` | Der Anmeldecode stimmt nicht. |
| 409 | `name_taken` | Dieser Name ist schon vergeben. |
| 404 | `player_not_found` | Dieses Konto gibt es nicht. |
| 404 | `lan_not_found` | Diese LAN gibt es nicht. |
| 409 | `lan_full` | Diese LAN ist schon voll. |
| 409 | `lan_overlap` | Der Zeitraum überschneidet sich mit einer LAN. |
| 400 | `not_a_bot` | Das ist kein Bot. Echte Spieler steuert niemand von außen. |
| 409 | `lan_has_players` | An dieser LAN nehmen schon Spieler teil, deshalb lässt sie sich nicht löschen. |
| 409 | `slug_taken` | Dieser Kurzname ist schon vergeben. |
| 404 | `area_not_found` | Diesen Bereich gibt es nicht. |
| 409 | `area_not_assignable` | In diesem Bereich kann kein Jelly stehen. |
| 400 | `invalid_area` | Dieser Bereich passt nicht auf die Bühne oder hat keine bekannte Art. |
| 400 | `invalid_rules` | xp_per_level lässt sich nach dem Start der LAN nicht mehr ändern. |
| 400 | `invalid_name` | Der Name muss 1 bis 24 Zeichen lang sein und darf keine Steuerzeichen enthalten. |
| 400 | `invalid_color` | Diese Farbe gibt es nicht. |

| 403 | `seat_code_other_account` | Dieser Sitzplatz-Code gehört zu einem anderen Konto. Fehlt dein Konto auf diesem Gerät, gibt dir die Orga einen Wiederherstellungs-Code. |
| 403 | `invalid_recovery_code` | Dieser Wiederherstellungs-Code stimmt nicht oder ist abgelaufen. |
| 400 | `unknown_slot` | Diesen Platz für Cosmetics gibt es nicht. |

| 400 | `invalid_cosmetic_color` | Diese Farbe geht hier nicht. |

info.title: Jelly API

post.description: The orga creates the code for one account. It works once, without a LAN or a seat. The answer holds a new secret, and the old one stops working. An unknown, used or expired code answers `403 invalid_recovery_code`.
post.summary: Bring back an account whose secret is lost, with a recovery code

post.description: With a bearer secret, that account joins and keeps its secret. Without one, a new account appears, which needs name and color. A seat code also gives the seat, unless it is taken or the account has another one: then the code is used up, the account is in the LAN, `seat_assigned` is false and the orga assigns a seat. Seats are never given out by chance. A seat code bound to another account answers `403 seat_code_other_account` and stays valid, a used one `409 code_redeemed`. A wrong secret answers `401`, so never send a secret the server rejected before.
post.summary: Bring an account into a LAN with a code

get.description: Works without an account. Clients read keys, names and labels from here instead of hard-coding them. Secret achievements are not listed.

put.description: Without `key`, the slot is emptied. `color` is hex text from `cosmetic_colors` in the catalog and only works for colorable cosmetics.
put.summary: Put on a cosmetic or empty a slot

post.description: All screens hear about it through the event `emote`. Can answer `unknown_emote` and `emote_cooldown`.
Earns the XP of the code once per player. Can answer `invalid_event_code` and `event_code_redeemed`.
Lights up the top of a stack and everyone on it earns `lighthouse`, the top also `lighthouse-light`.
post.summary: Light up a jelly on the stage, so it can be found

get.description: Works without an account. With a token, `joined` says whether this player takes part in the running LAN.

get.description: Lets an app bring back its popups after a restart.
get.summary: Read the own open partner emotes, for example after a restart

patch.summary: Accept, decline or cancel a partner emote

post.description: The other client learns about it from `partner_emote.updated` and answers with PATCH. Jellies further apart than `near_distance` get `409 too_far`.
post.summary: Ask another jelly for a partner emote

patch.description: Missing fields stay unchanged, and an empty request changes nothing and sends no event. Can answer `invalid_name`, `invalid_color` and `name_taken`.

post.description: A poke that comes too early is no error, it earns `xp_gained: 0`.
Send this every few minutes. Without it, a jelly falls asleep once `presence_window` passed since the last action.
post.summary: Keep the jelly awake while the app runs, without XP

post.description: Earns XP within the rules of the LAN. Can answer `report_cooldown`, `report_limit`, `no_active_lan` and `not_joined`. After a report the jelly walks to a zone of kind `queue` for `snack_run_seconds`.

put.description: The sign stays up until it is lowered or replaced. Answers `unknown_sign` for a key that is not in the catalog.

post.description: Everyone nearby can climb on it with `POST /v1/stacks/members`. It falls apart after `stack_seconds`. Starting a stack ends a trip or following.

delete.description: The jellies above slide down one level.

post.description: A stack further away than `near_distance` answers `409 too_far`.

get.description: Takes a player secret or the stage key. Afterwards open the stream with `since` set to `last_event_id`. `moves` holds the current walk of each jelly.
get.summary: Read all visible jellies and areas

get.description:
Starts after `Last-Event-ID`, then `since`, otherwise at the newest event. Players can only go back 1000 events, further back they get `reset` and read their state again. `topics` is a comma-separated list of `events` and `moves`, without it both arrive. Messages of type `move` have no ID and carry a `Move`. Every new connection first gets the current move of each jelly. Above the limits of the LAN for open streams, the answer is `429 rate_limited`.

**Messages:** The SSE message type equals `type`.

| Type | Meaning | `player_id` | `payload` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `player.active` | A jelly came to the stage. | the player | `{}` |
| `player.updated` | A jelly changed. | the player | `{}`, or `{"edited":true}` if the player changed it |
| `player.hidden` | The orga hid a jelly. | the player | `{}` |
| `player.removed` | An account was deleted. | null | `{"player_id"}` |
| `xp.gained` | A player earned XP. `source` is `poke`, `food`, `drink`, `event` or `partner`. | the player | `{"amount","source"}` |
| `level.up` | A player reached a new level. | the player | `{"level"}` |
| `achievement.earned` | A player earned an achievement. | the player | `{"key"}` |
| `award.given` | The orga gave a prize. `title` is free text. | the player | `{"title"}` |
| `emote` | A jelly plays an emote. | the player | `{"key"}` |
| `partner.emote` | Two jellies play a partner emote. The event names who accepted and who asked. Without an event, one of them is hidden. | who accepted | `{"key","partner_id"}`, `partner_id` is who asked |
| `partner_emote.updated` | A partner emote was created or changed. The app of an invited jelly finds itself in `partner_id` and shows its popup. | who acted | `{"id","key","from_id","partner_id","state","expires_at"}` |
| `sign.changed` | A jelly raised or lowered a sign. | the player | `{"key"}`, null when lowered |
| `follow.changed` | A jelly started following, or following ended, also when its time ran out. | the player | `{"target_id"}`, null when it ended |
| `trip.changed` | A jelly started a trip, or its trip ended, also when its time ran out. | the player | `{"x","y","ends_at"}`, null when it ended |
| `stack.changed` | A stack was started, changed or ended, also when its time ran out. | the player, null when its time ran out | The stack, only `{"id"}` after climbing down or when it ended |
| `highlight` | A jelly lights up so it can be found. It shows the aura `cosmetic_key` instead of its own one until `ends_at`. | who asked | `{"target_id","ends_at","cosmetic_key"}` |
| `stage.changed` | The room changed, so read `GET /v1/stage` again. | null | `{}` |
| `rules.changed` | The orga changed the rules of a LAN, so read `GET /lans/current` again. | null | `{}` |
| `gathering.changed` | A gathering started or ended, also when its time ran out. | null | The `Gathering`, null when it ended |
| `move` | A jelly starts a walk. This message has no ID and is not part of the event log. | `player_id` of the move | The data is a whole `Move`, not an `Event` |
| `reset` | The stream dropped events for this client, so read the state again. | none | None |

parameters.description: The last event ID the client knows, usually `last_event_id` from a state it just read.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Sent by the browser or the client when it reconnects, and takes priority over `since`.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

parameters.description: The stage key, for the stage page. Players send their secret as a bearer token instead.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of `events` and `moves`. Without it, both arrive. Unknown topics answer `400 invalid_request`.
parameters.name: topics

200.description: A stream where the data of each message is one event

delete.description: Ends a trip or following at once, and the jelly walks back to its place.
delete.summary: Go back to the own place

post.description: The jelly walks back after `follow_seconds`, see `follow.ends_at`. The server may end this by itself, so read `follow_player_id` instead of assuming it stays set.

`x` and `y` are percent of the stage, also the seat of someone else. A point in a zone with `blocks` answers `400 invalid_trip`. The jelly walks to the free spot closest to the point and back after `trip_seconds`. This ends following.
post.summary: Walk to a point and come back after a while

get.description: Works without an account and stays at this path for every API version, so old apps can always find out that they need an update.
get.summary: Read the API version and the oldest app that still works
